scenarios.test: prepare online-only vs downloaded files in real OneDrive File Provider
scenarios.evidence: brctl evict refused: 'Path is outside of any CloudDocs app library' (BRCloudDocsErrorDomain 6); fileproviderctl exposes no evict command; OneDrive app has no CLI/automation; onedrive.live.com unreachable from this network (ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED)
scenarios.impact: no dataless file could be produced; all 8 fixtures stayed hydrated

scenarios.test: logical vs allocated bytes, cache and File Provider state
scenarios.evidence: 8 files: logical 22 232 B, allocated 49 152 B (4 KiB block granularity); File Provider state only via fileproviderctl dump (default domain only, no per-item dataless flag)
scenarios.impact: storage overhead measurable, online-only state NOT_VERIFIED

scenarios.test: index, browse, search, sort, tags, custom metadata, smart groups
scenarios.evidence: index 8 files in 0.95 s; content search PASS (5/4 hits after restart); tags written & readable (count 4 after 2 hierarchical tags); custom metadata write/read PASS (project_code=HC26-041); custom-metadata key search 'project_code:HC26-041' returned 0; sort is UI-only (NOT_VERIFIED); no smart-group class in DEVONthink 4.4.2 sdef (creation NOT_SUPPORTED via AppleScript)

scenarios.test: Free Up Space limited to test files, then observe space/behaviour
scenarios.evidence: same eviction block as B1; no space could be reclaimed
DEVONthink quit/reopen: searches still return 5/4 hits; preview/open of a dataless file NOT_VERIFIED (no dataless file exists)

scenarios.test: metadata sync with indexed content sync disabled
scenarios.evidence: no sync location configured ('synchronize' returns false); creating one requires cloud credentials/second device

scenarios.test: fresh isolated profile / second device restore of metadata, smart groups, index references
scenarios.evidence: no second device or fresh macOS profile authorized

scenarios.test: read/write record UUID, tags, custom fields
scenarios.evidence: UUID read per record; tags written (2 hierarchical tags → 4 tag objects); custom metadata 'project_code'/'bid_year' written and read back; tag-name iteration via AppleScript fails in 4.4.2 (count only)

scenarios.test: identity under rename, same-volume move, parent-folder rename, content update
scenarios.evidence: UUID 2A0F8235-…-ED4D unchanged across all four operations; custom metadata HC26-041 retained; content hash d2deeb26… → 8b500efb… after edit; old paths resolve to NONE
no second device, web access blocked

index→sorty move: UUID E293415C-… stable, path updated, hash unchanged; re-apply of the same plan refused with destination-exists / source-missing errors (no partial writes); sorty-then-index created record 915DFCA9-…

scenarios.test: distinguish physical file identity, DT record identity, path and content hash
scenarios.evidence: path changes while UUID and metadata stay fixed; content hash changes only on byte change; deletion+recreate at same path kept UUID with stale hash until refresh
identity held in every testable scenario, fallback not required
conditional route; DEVONthink did not materially fail on identity
